title: Tenant heatmap + priority fallback with retry-synchronizer to stem customer-visible 5xx waves
creator: Aisha Morales
description:
Summary:
During the last customer escalation, we observed tenant-localized 5xx/timeouts amplified by client SDK retries and edge fanout. This ticket implements a cross-layer mitigation: (1) a tenant-heatmap that signals overloaded tenants in real time to the admission layer; (2) a priority-fallback policy that routes impacted tenants to a controlled degraded fastpath (smaller batches, disabled kv-prefetch, quantized model variant); and (3) a retry-synchronizer service in the edge proxy that enforces coordinated per-tenant backoff windows and deduplicates idempotent client retries.

Goals:
- Rapidly reduce customer-visible 5xx/timeouts for escalated tenants while preserving best-effort throughput for other tenants.
- Provide clear telemetry (heatmap + incident dashboard) and an operator-facing runbook so on-call can enable automatic fallback during waves.
- Ship a short-term hotfix (edge proxy patch) and a medium-term rollout (retry-synchronizer + heatmap integrated into routing).
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant heatmap available in console showing request rate, error-rate, and kv-cache pressure (hot, warm, cold) for top 200 tenants
Priority fallback policy can be toggled per-tenant and reduces customer-visible 5xx for impacted tenant by >= 80% within 5 minutes of enablement during a synthetic surge test
Retry-synchronizer enforces per-tenant rolling backoff windows and reduces downstream duplicate request rate by >= 60% in Canary region
Hotfix PR for proxy (edge) merged and rolled to staging; post-deploy dashboard demonstrates immediate reduction in amplification metrics
Runbook and on-call checklist published (Confluence) with exact play steps, telemetry queries, and rollback gates
implementation_steps: Instrument heatmap telemetry: add per-tenant counters (requests/s, 5xx/s, kv_evictions/s, avg_latency_ms) to the ingestion pipeline
Build a heatmap view in the Console prototype page and expose API for admission layer to poll top-100 overloaded tenants
Create priority fallback config: model_variant, batch_size_limit, kv_prefetch=false, quantization_profile
Implement retry-synchronizer in edge proxy: token-bucket per-tenant, idempotency dedupe window, and synchronized jittered backoff
Smoke tests: synthetic tenant surge up to 10x baseline with and without fallback; collect error amplification ratio
Canary rollout to a single region and one reserved Dedicated cluster tenant group
Complete runbook, onboard on-call, and schedule followup postmortem
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Fallback may increase latency for degraded tenants. Mitigation: tight SLA in config and metric-based automatic rollback if latency exceeds threshold
Risk: Heatmap polling overhead could add load. Mitigation: sampling + delta push from runtime with 5s aggregation window

Risk: Incorrect idempotency dedupe could drop legitimate distinct requests if clients mis-set idempotency keys. Mitigation: default to conservative dedupe and document client semantics; provide emergency disable toggle

Risk: Cross-environment config differences (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) complicate rollout. Mitigation: runtime-agnostic policy definitions with environment flags; coordinate with Private deployment team for config packaging
